name: list_background_tasks
description: List tasks. With scope="children" (default), lists the child tasks this task started with new_task. With scope="peers", lists all tasks sharing the same root task (siblings, aunts/uncles, grandchildren) — not just direct children. Returns each task's ID, title, current status, and creation timestamp. Use it to find the task id you need for send_message, check_task_status or cancel_tasks.

scope.description: "children" (default): list only this task's direct background children. "peers": list all tasks sharing the same rootTaskId, excluding self.
